steps.action: Describe what it should cover (or use the example)
steps.description: A slide pack for the working session with BPUC staff on 4 November. One slide with the rate base at 31 December 2026 and how it compares with 2025. One slide on plant in service by class, gross and net of depreciation. One slide on how the rate base moved since the 2025 order. One slide on what is used and useful at the test year end, with the seven projects dated 2027. One slide on the prudence record of the major additions and the two gaps. Close with the sources and as-of dates.
